body:
Failing test `tests/test_polygons.py::test_a_marginal_tau_is_refused_at_setup_not_at_nan_time`.

```
def test_a_marginal_tau_is_refused_at_setup_not_at_nan_time() -> None:
        """The failure this rung actually hit: ``tau = 0.5346`` ran 26727 steps and
        reported ``Cd = nan``. D-016's 0.53 floor lets that through; this one does
        not, and it names the ``D`` that fixes it.
        """
        assert TAU_FLOOR > 0.53
>       with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="stability floor"):
E       AssertionError: Regex pattern did not match.
E         Expected regex: 'stability floor'
E         Actual message: 'tau = 0.5346 is at or below the 0.537 floor for Re = 100.0, U = 0.055, D = 21. Measured (D-029): a disc at tau = 0.5330 blows up by step 1500 and a square at 0.5346 by step 3200, while 0.5378 survives 60000 steps. Use D >= 22 cells or raise U (subject to the 0.1 ceiling).'

tests\test_polygons.py:159: AssertionError
```
dropped_reason: Transient during T010: Rung 3's TAU_FLOOR rose to 0.537 (Q-004), so tau=0.5346 is now refused by the inner floor and Rung 4's own message no longer fires for that case. Test updated in the same session; a second test now pins the 0.537-0.54 band as Rung 4's alone.
title: [test] tests/test_polygons.py::test_a_marginal_tau_is_refused_at_setup_not_at_nan_time: tests\test_polygons.py:159: AssertionError

body: `.gitignore` lines 14-15 are `*/__init__.py` and `__init__.py`, and line 17 is `tools`. Consequences, verified with `git ls-files` in session 16: lbm/backends/__init__.py has been untracked since T101 (the Backend protocol is not in the repo), and the whole of tools/ is untracked although CLAUDE.md documents `python -m tools.issues` and calls DOCS/ISSUES.jsonl committed. lbm/__init__.py and validate/__init__.py are tracked only because they predate the rule; flow/__init__.py was force-added in session 16. A fresh clone cannot import lbm.backends and has no issue queue tooling. Fix is to drop the two __init__.py lines and the `tools` line from .gitignore and add the missing files - but it touches lbm/ and repo-wide config, so it wants its own task rather than being folded into a product task (DOCS/PLAN2.md Risks, last row).
title: [repo] .gitignore drops every __init__.py: lbm/backends and tools/ are untracked
